# Paired original-KVM calculations

us/op = elapsed_ms * 1000 / operations.
Speedup = reference_us / candidate_us within the SAME sample.
Reported speedup is median(paired ratios), NOT ratio(medians).
Time reduction = 100 * (1 - 1 / speedup). Min/max are observed, not confidence intervals.
